indexing_requirements: Corpus estimate: ~120M documents (pdfs, OCR, emails). Languages: EN, FR, ES, PT, DE, NL, RU, AR, ZH, JA, IT, PL (12 lang). Embedding dims: 1536 preferred. Candidate generation: ANN at 50-200 candidates; reranker cross-encoder for top-50. Target latency: p50 < 120ms end-to-end for candidate gen + rerank (POC target), p95 < 400ms; SLA target for production p95 < 600ms. Cost target: <$0.02/query (average) at 100k qps/month. Per-language recall targets (top-10): EN>=0.92, FR>=0.88, ES>=0.86, PT>=0.80, RU>=0.78, AR>=0.74, ZH>=0.76. Need per-language precision tuning + fallback routing when recall below threshold.
poc_success_criteria: Indexing complete within 5 business days for 120M docs (sample pipeline). Achieve top-10 recall targets per-language listed above. Latency: p50 <120ms, p95 <400ms on our POC dataset. Cost projection produced for 6-month run. Provide runbook: batching, KV caching, quantization suggestions, reranker distillation options.
poC_requirements: 1) Hosted POC with sanitized dataset + NDA 2) Perf sweep: candidate gen config x rerank model variants 3) Per-language evaluation sets (they will provide ~500 labeled queries per language) 4) Cost/throughput projection and dedicated pricing alternative 5) Security addendum for EU residency if moving to production.
sales_notes: High technical maturity on their side; SE heavy. Buying group: Legal (security/compliance), Search Platform team (engineers), Procurement. Real blocker is legal/data-residency signoff and per-language relevance for non-Latin scripts. Upsell into Dedicated if perf & residency checks pass.
technical_risks: Rerank latency at top-k=50 for heavy cross-encoder on dedicated hardware; low-resource languages show lower recall and require task-specific fine-tuning or prompt augmentation. Indexing cost could exceed their budget without strong caching or quantization recommendations.
